context: This is a declared falsification of the observed v1.281 negative association, not a pristine preoutcome hypothesis. Do not reclassify output as independent confirmation or pursue alternate tuning on failure.
question: Does Pico's v1.281 focal-native lower introduced-taxon exposure persist after deterministic projection of introduced richness onto overall native plot taxon richness and continuously ranked elevation?
scope: Pico 24 independently keyed 10x10m original author plots; other three islands are not pooled into a new primary

variables.Y: Count distinct species-rank introduced plants per plot across four subplots; collapse same taxon within plot
variables.X1: Continuous within-island fractional midrank of frozen median author plot elevation (24 plots); tied values midrank
variables.X2: Count distinct species-rank native/endemic taxa per plot including historical-loss focal taxa; species counted once per plot
variables.focal: One of fixed 20 S1 strict Azores island-level local-loss taxa, when in 2013 native-source records
variables.reference: Every other original 2013 native/endemic species in Pico plots (49 taxa); same validation as v1.281

analysis.standardization: For the 24 Pico sites, center each X column and divide by root-mean-square deviation, default z=0 for a constant input; no response-dependent bins or thresholds
analysis.ridge: Fixed slope L2 penalty lambda=1.0 on the two standardized predictors; intercept unpenalized. Solve normal 2x2 equations using full 24 plot Y and X without focal labels; no cross-validation or tuning.
analysis.target: For each focal/reference taxon average plot residual Y-predicted(Y|X1,X2) across occupied plots, then mean across taxa equally; report focal-minus-reference in introduced species per plot; negative supports descriptive robustness, regardless of strength.
analysis.secondary: Plot group residual mean focal-any-positive minus focal-negative; report raw native richness plot means by group, beta coefficients and fitted-signal spread as sensitivity only
analysis.self_inclusion: Total native richness includes the focal or reference species symmetrically when present; this is a habitat proxy not an exogenous covariate. No causal interpretation.

validation: Source-locked v1.281 aggregate recomputation must match exactly; 58/232/2539, 20/24, Pico focal 5/reference 49, introduced plot×taxon 27, native plot×taxon 292; stop on discrepancy
firewall: Retrospective source re-read only the already exposed 2013 MOVECLIM and S1; original 529 mammal, BioTIME reserved, RLS, Macaronesia S2/S3/S4, and old Pico GPS5 remain untouched; no eBird, GEB HOLD, zero confirmatory
interpretation_ceiling: A negative adjusted residual difference remains a within-2013 sampled-vegetation association, not an alien introduction treatment effect or proof of biological island refugium, colonization, survival, donor viability or rescue.
